note.note:
Please supply the actual content for both of the following blocks so I can generate the structured Note:

- Transcript: paste the full doctor–patient conversation (text only).
- Differential Diagnosis (DDx): paste the JSON or structured list exactly as provided.

What I will produce once you provide them:
- A structured Problem List Clinical Note with the exact headings you requested:
  - Consult Summary: two-line summary
  - Problem List: Issue 1, Issue 2, Issue 3 (each with description, timeline, ROS, social/med history, exam findings if mentioned, and DDx items only if consistent with the transcript, with likelihood tags and brief justification)
  - Medications: list with dosing details if provided; otherwise note “dose/route/frequency not documented” as needed
  - Allergies
  - Past Medical History
  - Social History
  - Preventative History
  - Physical Examination: vitals and exam findings as provided
  - Plan: actions, tests, treatments, referrals, follow-up
  - Quality checks: document_quality section with missing elements, conflict notes if any, and transcript quality comment

Key rules I will apply:
- Treat the transcript as the primary clinical source; use the DDx only to clarify/determine differential if consistent with the transcript.
- Do not invent data beyond what is in the transcript or DDx.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name and add “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If the transcript and DDx conflict, I will include both and mark “conflict noted.”

Please provide the actual content to proceed.
